data.gender_notes: Hillery is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English 'heh' meaning 'hill' and 'leah' meaning 'clearing'. Hillery may refer to a person living on or near a hill, or a clearing in a hilly area. In Christianity, the name may symbolize the journey of faith, which involves both climbing hills to reach new heights and finding clearings of peace and rest. The name Hillery carries the meaning “Hill, clearing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hillery usually hope their child will grow to embody hill, clearing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
